name: test-explorer-for-unity
description: Run Unity Edit Mode and Play Mode tests from the VS Code Testing tab, in your open Editor or in a background worker that keeps it free.

commands.title: Unity Tests: Install or Update the Test Bridge

unityTests.maxTestsPerRun.description: Ask where to run when a run has more tests than this, since tests slow the Editor down while they run. 0 removes the limit.

unityTests.sourceGlob.description: Files searched to link tests to their source. Empty finds them from your test assembly definitions.
